s1.syndrome_frame: Palpitations in a pregnant patient with regular tachycardia and variable first heart sound
salient_findings: Regular cannon waves in jugular venous pulsations
key_facts: Patient is a primigravid in their 20s
Patient is in the eighth month of gestation
Palpitations are nonexertional and episodic
Palpitations last for a few minutes and subside spontaneously
No associated sweating, syncope, dyspnoea, orthopnoea, or paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea
Blood pressure is 110/70 mm Hg
Heart rate is 120 beats/min
Jugular venous pulsations reveal regular cannon waves
Auscultation is significant for a variable first heart sound
Laboratory tests are within normal limits
2-dimensional transthoracic echocardiography shows good biventricular function and normally functioning valves
ECG shows regular narrow QRS tachycardia
